_about: Connector display names and marks: MCP server id (a claude.ai connector's id as it appears in mcp__<id>__<tool>, or a server name) -> name and the logo file in logos/ (without .svg). The three UUIDs are the mock scenario's own, invented (fixtures/junior-swe/FIXTURE.md). Name your own connectors in connectors.json in the app's data folder (beside its cache folder), which is read over this file.
